risk_if_not_implemented: Without Post-Sensitive / Regulated Data Spill Operations, security incidents may not be detected, contained, investigated or communicated in a timely manner, increasing their scope, duration and cost. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Reduced Operational Productivity (R-BC-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Incident Response Plan (IRP)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to maintain and make available a current and viable Incident Response Plan (IRP) to all stakeholders.
compensating_control_1.justification: Incident Response Plan (IRP) (IRO-08) provides incident response capability that compensates for the absence of Post-Sensitive / Regulated Data Spill Operations (IRO-20.3) by enabling timely detection, containment, and recovery from security events in the absence of the primary control. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Sensitive / Regulated Data Spill Response
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to respond to sensitive and/or regulated data spills.
compensating_control_2.justification: Sensitive / Regulated Data Spill Response (IRO-20) provides incident response capability that compensates for the absence of Post-Sensitive / Regulated Data Spill Operations (IRO-20.3) by enabling timely detection, containment, and recovery from security events in the absence of the primary control. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
